entries.title: Luke 22:1
segments: Now the festival of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, was drawing near.

entries.title: Luke 22:2
segments: The high priest and the Scribes continually sought means to put him to death.

entries.title: Luke 22:3
segments: Satan however, entered into Judas (the man called Iscariot), who was one of the twelve.

entries.title: Luke 22:4
segments: And he went out and conferred with the chief priests and commanders

entries.title: Luke 22:5
segments: They were delighted, and agreed to give him money.

entries.title: Luke 22:6
segments: He consented to this, and looked for an opportunity to betray him, when the people were not present.

entries.title: Luke 22:7
segments: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread, on which the paschal lamb must be sacrificed.

entries.title: Luke 22:8
segments: So Jesus went to Peter and John saying, "Go and prepare for us the Passover, that we may eat it."

entries.title: Luke 22:9
segments: "Where shall we get it ready?" they asked.

entries.title: Luke 22:10
segments: He answered: "No sooner will you have entered the city than you will meet a man carrying a water-jug. Follow him into the house were he is going.

entries.title: Luke 22:11
segments: "And to the good man of the house say, `The teacher asks you, "Where is the room in which I can eat the Passover with my disciples?"'

entries.title: Luke 22:12
segments: "Then he will show you a large upper room furnished. There make your preparations."

entries.title: Luke 22:13
segments: So they went and found everything as he had told them, they prepared the Passover.

entries.title: Luke 22:14
segments: And when the hour was come he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him,

entries.title: Luke 22:15
segments: and he said to them: "With desire have I longed to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

entries.title: Luke 22:16
segments: For I tell you that I certainly will not eat again until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God."

entries.title: Luke 22:17
segments: Then he had received a cup and given thanks, he said,

entries.title: Luke 22:18
segments: "Take this, and divide it among yourselves; for I tell you that I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God is come."

entries.title: Luke 22:19
segments: And he took a loaf, and after giving thanks, he broke it and gave it to them saying: "This is my body, which is given for you; this do in remembrance of me.'

entries.title: Luke 22:20
segments: He gave them a cup in like manner, after supper saying: "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, poured out for your sake.

entries.title: Luke 22:21
segments: "But behold, the hand of my betrayer is at the table with me!

entries.title: Luke 22:22
segments: "The Son of man indeed goes on his way, as it has been determined; but woe to that man by who he is betrayed."

entries.title: Luke 22:23
segments: And they began to question among themselves which of them it could be who was going to do such a thing.

entries.title: Luke 22:24
segments: And there arose also a dispute among them as to which of them could be considered the greatest,

entries.title: Luke 22:25
segments: and he said to them: "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who have who have authority over them are called Benefactors.

entries.title: Luke 22:26
segments: "But you shall not be so. But he who is greater among you let him become like the younger; and he who is leader like him who serves.

entries.title: Luke 22:27
segments: "For which is greater, he who sits at table, or he who serves? Is it not he who sits at table? But I am in your midst as one who serves.

entries.title: Luke 22:28
segments: "You, however, are those who have stood by me in my trials.

entries.title: Luke 22:29
segments: "And I promise you a kingdom, even as my Father has promised me a kingdom;

entries.title: Luke 22:30
segments: "so that you shall eat and drink in my kingdom, and you shall sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Luke 22:31
segments: "Simon, Simon," said the Lord, "behold, Satan has asked to have you all that he might sift you like wheat.

entries.title: Luke 22:32
segments: "But I made supplication for you that your own faith may not fail. And you, when you have turned again, must strengthen your brothers."

entries.title: Luke 22:33
segments: "Lord," Simon said to him, "I am ready to go with you, both to prison and to death."

entries.title: Luke 22:34
segments: "I tell you, Peter," he answered. "the cock will not crow this day until you will three times deny that you know me."

entries.title: Luke 22:35
segments: Moreover, he said to them, "When I sent you out without purse or wallet or sandals, did you lack anything?" They answered him, "We lacked nothing.'

entries.title: Luke 22:36
segments: Then he said to them: "But now let him who has a purse take it, and he who has a wallet, let him the do the same. And he who has no sword, let him sell his cloak and buy one.

entries.title: Luke 22:37
segments: "For I say to you that this word of Scripture must find it's fulfilment in me: "And he was numbered among the transgressors, For that which concerns me has its accomplishment."

entries.title: Luke 22:38
segments: "Master" they said, "here are two swords!" "That is enough," he answered.

entries.title: Luke 22:39
segments: Then he went out, and began to go to the Mount of Olives, as was his wont; and his disciples followed him.

entries.title: Luke 22:40
segments: But he arrived at the place he said to them, "Pray that you enter not into temptation."

entries.title: Luke 22:41
segments: But he himself withdrew from them about a stone's throw, kneeling down he prayed repeatedly, saying:

entries.title: Luke 22:42
segments: "Father, if thou art willing, take away this cup from me; but thy will, not mine, be done!"

entries.title: Luke 22:43
segments: (And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.

entries.title: Luke 22:44
segments: (And being in agony he kept praying more earnestly; and his sweat became as if it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.)

entries.title: Luke 22:45
segments: When he arose from his prayers, and came to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

entries.title: Luke 22:46
segments: and said to them: "Why are you asleep? Get up, and pray that you enter not into temptation."

entries.title: Luke 22:47
segments: While he was still speaking there came a crowd, and he who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus in order to kiss him,

entries.title: Luke 22:48
segments: but Jesus said to him, "Judas, you are betraying the Son of man with a kiss?"

entries.title: Luke 22:49
segments: Those who were around him, when they saw what was about to happen, said to him, "Lord, shall we strike with our swords?"

entries.title: Luke 22:50
segments: Then one of them did strike a blow at the high priest's slave, and cut off his right ear.

entries.title: Luke 22:51
segments: "Permit me to do this at least," said Jesus, as he touched his ear and healed him.

entries.title: Luke 22:52
segments: Then Jesus said to the corps of priests and captains of the temple and elders who had come out to arrest him: "Have ye come for me with swords and clubs to arrest me like a robber?

entries.title: Luke 22:53
segments: "When daily I was with you in the temple you did not stretch out your hands to take me; but this is your hour and the power of darkness."

entries.title: Luke 22:54
segments: So they seized him and led him away, and took him to the house of the high priest; while Peter was following him a long way off.

entries.title: Luke 22:55
segments: And when they had lighted a fire in the center of the court, and had sat down together, Peter was taking his seat among them.

entries.title: Luke 22:56
segments: But a certain maid servant saw him taking his seat near the fire and, with a sharp glance at him, she said, "This fellow was with him, too!"

entries.title: Luke 22:57
segments: But he denied it, saying, "Woman, I know nothing about him."

entries.title: Luke 22:58
segments: A little later a man saw him, and said, "You too are one of them" But Peter declared, "Man, I am not."

entries.title: Luke 22:59
segments: But an hour afterwards another man kept insisting, saying: "Really , this fellow was with him. Why, he is a Galilean."

entries.title: Luke 22:60
segments: "Man," said Peter, "I do not know what you mean." And immediately, while he was still speaking, the cock crew.

entries.title: Luke 22:61
segments: Then the Lord turned and looked at Peter, and Peter recollected the word of the Lord, how he had said to him, "This very day, before the cock crows, you will deny me three times."

entries.title: Luke 22:62
segments: And Peter went outside and wept with bitter crying.

entries.title: Luke 22:63
segments: Meanwhile the men who were holding Jesus in custody kept mocking and striking him.

entries.title: Luke 22:64
segments: They would blindfold him and ask him: "Prophesy! Tell who struck you!"

entries.title: Luke 22:65
segments: And they said many other insulting things against him.

entries.title: Luke 22:66
segments: When it became the day the elders if the people met with the high priests and the Scribes and had brought before the Sanhedrin, saying:

entries.title: Luke 22:67
segments: "Are you the Christ? Tell us!" "If I tell you," he answered, "you will not believe;

entries.title: Luke 22:68
segments: "And if I ask you, you will not answer.

entries.title: Luke 22:69
segments: "But from henceforth the Son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God."

entries.title: Luke 22:70
segments: Then they all said, "Are you then the Son of God."

entries.title: Luke 22:71
segments: "What need we of further evidence? for we ourselves have heard it from his own lips."
